column1: # Pool: every sample with both haplotypes present in the ACOT graph -- 232 samples.
# This manifest exists because round 13 discovered ACOT had none. The C4 manifest
# (tests/genotype_development_donors.tsv) is C4-only: its pool is the samples in c4.gfa.gz, it does not
# contain HG00097, and nothing outside its own simulation.tsv recorded which donor the ACOT pilots had
# been using. A donor that has been looked at repeatedly during development cannot later be presented
# as held-out validation, so the fact is frozen here instead of being reconstructed later.
# HOW HG00097 WAS CHOSEN, precisely: it was not drawn. It is the donor the round-11 2x ACOT pilot used
# and the round-13 2x/10x/30x coverage pilots reused, so its truth has already influenced development
# decisions. Recording it as `development` with selection `prior-use` states that honestly. This is
# NOT the hashed draw the C4 manifest documents, and it must not be described as one.
# Every other sample in the pool is held out and is not listed. Adding a donor here after its truth
# has been examined is the failure this file prevents; adding one before is a decision to record.
